data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate, being in run-off, recorded a gross claims reserve strengthening of GBP 0.805m in 2023. This movement is attributed to a cautious approach to reserving in recognition of inherent uncertainties and inflationary impacts. As no new business was written in 2023, all claims outstanding movements relate to prior underwriting years, including the 2021 and 2022 years of account.
raw_causal_phrases: cautious approach to reserving in recognition of the inherent uncertainty of forecasting inflationary impacts
data.data_quality_notes: The 'Change in claims outstanding' (Gross 805k) from Note 14 is used as prior year development, assuming all movement relates to prior years due to the syndicate being in run-off with no new underwriting in 2023. The gross premium mix is taken from the narrative summary on page 5, which provides a clear percentage breakdown by line of business, rather than the detailed table on page 34 which had a slight discrepancy between line items and total.
